MLSP.description: Moving Load Support - Negative Moment (MLSP). TYPE selects the input mode: 'User Input' drives element-based fields (ELEMENT_NO, ELEMENT_TYPE, and POSITION when the element is a BEAM), while 'Auto Input' drives GROUP_NAME (a structure group).

TYPE.description: Input mode. 'User Input' assigns the negative-moment support to a specific element (ELEMENT_NO); 'Auto Input' assigns it via a structure group (GROUP_NAME). Case-insensitive.

ELEMENT_NO.description: [TYPE=User Input] Element number the support is applied to. Must be an existing element.

ELEMENT_TYPE.description: [TYPE=User Input] Element type of ELEMENT_NO. When BEAM, POSITION is required; PLATE does not use POSITION. Case-insensitive.

POSITION.description: [TYPE=User Input, ELEMENT_TYPE=BEAM] Support position along the beam element. Required when the element is a BEAM. Case-insensitive.

GROUP_NAME.description: [TYPE=Auto Input] Structure group name the support is applied to. Must reference an existing group when non-empty.
